subject: Ciências
description_pt: Selecionar exemplos de como a sucessão de dias e noites orienta o ritmo de atividades diárias de seres humanos e de outros seres vivos.

components.description_pt: Identificar exemplos de atividades humanas diárias reguladas pela sucessão de dia e noite
components.description_en: Identify examples of human daily activities regulated by the succession of day and night
components.cc_component_description: Explain how Earth's rotation on its axis causes the pattern of day and night

components.description_pt: Identificar exemplos de comportamentos em outros organismos vivos regulados pelo ciclo dia-noite
components.description_en: Identify examples of behaviors in other living organisms regulated by the day-night cycle
components.cc_component_description: Identify examples of traits that positively affect survival in a specific environment

components.description_pt: Explicar como a alternância de dia e noite cria padrões previsíveis de atividade e repouso
components.description_en: Explain how the alternation of day and night creates predictable patterns of activity and rest
components.cc_component_description: Explain how Earth's rotation on its axis causes the pattern of day and night

cc_matches.description: The orbits of Earth around the sun and of the moon around Earth, together with the rotation of Earth about an axis between its North and South poles, cause observable patterns. These include day and night; daily changes in the length and direction of shadows; and different positions of the sun, moon, and stars at different times of the day, month, and year.
The traits that positively affect survival are more likely to be reproduced, and thus are more common in the population.
